title: Weekend Activities
weather_note: Fri warm; storms late. Sat sharply cooler and breezy. Sun sunny, crisp. Check Friday evening event updates.

forecast.conditions: Morning fog, warm; showers and thunderstorms likely late
forecast.notable: Storms after 5 PM; check outdoor Friday evening plans.

forecast.conditions: Early showers possible; mostly sunny, breezy and much cooler

forecast_source: National Weather Service, Herndon VA, Oct 16 2026 2:23 AM EDT

events.title: Frying Pan Farm Harvest Fest & Carnival
events.time: Fri 5–9 PM (Big Trucks 5–7); Sat 10 AM–9 PM (farm 10–3); Sun 10 AM–6 PM (farm 10–3)
events.summary: See big trucks Friday, then traditional harvest demonstrations, livestock, games, carnival rides and food through the weekend. Farm Harvest Days run Saturday and Sunday 10 AM–3 PM.
events.registration: Ride wristbands $23.25 advance through Friday 5 PM; check storm updates.

events.title: Centreville Day
events.price: Free admission, parking and kids' activities
events.summary: Celebrate Centreville's history with a parade, reenactors, kids' activities, scavenger hunt, local performers and historic-site exhibits.
events.registration: Free shuttles from Trinity Centre and Centreville United Methodist Church.

events.title: Reston ChalkFest
events.price: Free to watch; registration for artists
events.summary: Watch colorful street murals take shape, vote for favorites, hear live music and visit face-painting activities. Families can register to make their own artwork.
events.registration: Registration required to compete; free to attend as spectator.

events.title: Cox Farms Fall Festival
events.summary: Spend a day on giant slides, rope swings, hayrides, farm-animal areas, seasonal play attractions and fall food.
events.registration: Tickets online only; dates can sell out.

events.title: Fields of Fear
events.price: Ticket required; price varies by date
events.summary: A separate nighttime haunted farm with scary attractions, designed for thrill seekers rather than young children.
events.registration: Online tickets only; check Friday storms.

events.title: Reston Farm Fall Fun Fest
events.summary: Ride the farm train, explore the inflatable corn maze, bounce, meet animals and snack on fresh cider donuts. Primarily aimed at children ages 3–12.
events.registration: Date-specific tickets; weather closure decision the previous evening.

events.title: nZone Fall Fun Fest & Trunk-or-Treat
events.summary: Free trunk-or-treat, inflatables, games, hot dogs, popcorn, raffles and an interactive children's show.
events.registration: Bring a candy bag.

events.title: Goblin Golf
events.summary: Play a Halloween-themed round of miniature golf with treats and seasonal decorations; costumes welcome.
events.registration: Advance ticket advised; sessions may sell out.

events.title: Family Fun Friday at Riverbend
events.time: From noon; closing time check with park
events.address: 8700 Potomac Hills St, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.summary: Drop in for picture books, crafts, puzzles, sand play, microscopes and a short naturalist presentation in the nature center.
events.registration: Check program timing and any fee with Riverbend.

events.title: Reston Home Tour
events.summary: Take a self-guided look inside architecturally distinctive Reston homes and learn about design choices and the community's history.
events.registration: Ticket and wristband required; addresses supplied to ticket holders.

events.title: Spooky Dry Ice Science
events.price: Registration fee; amount check with park
events.summary: Make bubbling concoctions and eerie dry-ice effects while learning about states of matter; ages 5 through adult.
events.registration: Children must be registered with a paying adult; confirm availability.

events.title: Historic Crafts and Trades at Colvin Run Mill
events.address: 10017 Colvin Run Rd, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.summary: Watch live blacksmithing, weaving, woodcarving, bookbinding and cider pressing; see the historic water-powered mill in operation.
events.registration: Registration required for all attending, ages 5+.

events.title: Bats: Friendly Flyers
events.summary: Join a naturalist to learn about local bats, their value to people and the environment, and ways to spot or listen for them.
events.registration: Ages 4+; check advance registration.

events.title: Campfire Fridays at Lake Fairfax
events.summary: Gather around a campfire with a naturalist for outdoor learning and s'mores.
events.registration: Age 5+; advance registration; check Friday storm forecast.

events.title: Middleburg Film Festival
events.time: Fri–Sat screenings about 9 AM–11 PM; Sun 9 AM–7 PM
events.venue: Salamander Resort (one of several festival venues)
events.summary: See new narrative and documentary films and join filmmaker conversations at venues around Middleburg. Check the program for each screening's exact location.
events.registration: Individual screening tickets and venue vary; buy for desired showing.

events.title: Lucketts Fall Vintage Market
events.time: Fri 12:30–5 PM (early buyers 8:30 AM); Sat–Sun 10 AM–5 PM
events.price: General admission $20+; children 12 and under free
events.summary: Shop 200+ vintage dealers for furniture, antiques, clothing and home décor, with music, food trucks and a beer garden.
events.registration: Special Friday early-buyer ticket required before 12:30 PM.

events.title: Celebrate Purcellville Fall Festival
events.summary: A community autumn celebration with carnival games, face painting, glitter tattoos, live music and food vendors.
events.registration: Check town event page for parking details.

events.title: Potomac Music Fall Fest
events.summary: Browse more than 50 crafts vendors, hear live music, play pumpkin games and enjoy seasonal food and drinks.
events.registration: No admission charge.

events.title: Falls Church Plein Air Festival
events.price: Free to watch; registration fee to compete
events.summary: See landscape and townscape paintings made outdoors, watch artists in the quick-draw competition and vote for People's Choice.
events.registration: Festival postponed to Oct 17; participation requires registration.

events.title: Great Country Farms Pumpkin Harvest
events.time: 9 AM–5 PM; last pumpkin wagon 4 PM
events.price: Gate $16 Fri; $18 Sat–Sun; age 2 and under free
events.summary: Pick pumpkins, try the corn maze, watch pig races and cider-press demos, play on giant slides and sample cider donuts. October weekends add pumpkin cannons and live music.
events.registration: Pumpkins cost extra; reservations required for weekend pumpkin picking.

events.title: Wright at Twilight
events.summary: Tour Frank Lloyd Wright's Pope-Leighey House at dusk, learn about its preservation, join an art activity and hear live music.
events.registration: Ticket includes one drink; much of event outdoors, check storms.

events.title: Boo at the Zoo
events.summary: Follow trick-or-treat stations through the zoo, attend a kid-friendly dance party and magic show, and visit selected animal houses after hours.
events.registration: Timed tickets required; parking extra; not nut-free.

events.title: The Big Build
events.summary: Hands-on construction and design activities for children, from woodworking and mosaic making to building challenges and demonstrations with trade professionals.
events.registration: Check event registration details.

events.title: Maryland Renaissance Festival
events.price: Adult $31+ tax and fees; children 6 and under free ticket
events.summary: Watch armored jousting, costumed street performers, live stage shows, artisans and period-themed food at the 50th-anniversary festival.
events.registration: Date-specific tickets online only; check availability.

events.title: Turkish Festival
events.summary: Explore Turkish food, folk dancing, musicians, traditional arts and crafts, coffee culture and activities for kids.
events.registration: Outdoor festival; check event updates.

events.title: Georgetown Fall Market
events.time: Sat–Sun daytime; exact vendor hours vary
events.venue: Georgetown Book Hill and Wisconsin Ave
events.summary: Walk Book Hill and Wisconsin Avenue for seasonal menus, neighborhood promotions, pop-ups and small local businesses.
events.registration: Free RSVP available; individual merchant hours vary.
